name: 2357-mixedprompt-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate = 100 req/s, warmup the first 10% of completed requests, bounded at 1000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: `configs/data/sharegpt-1000-llama.jsonl`: 1000 single-turn ShareGPT_V3 conversations, the first human turn as the prompt and the length of the first assistant turn as the output length, 248339 prompt and 240582 output tokens. `configs/data/make-dataset.py` regenerates the file. Sampling: n=1, best_of=1, temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k -1, no penalties, no logprobs, ignore_eos. `request_format: plain` is required, not preferred: the raw text is sent with no chat template, and applying this checkpoint's `[INST]` template would change every prompt's token count.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter Llama chat assistant handling a thousand varied single-turn questions at 100 arrivals per second on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: an operating point declared once and used unchanged.
#
# vLLM 0.3.3-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, not a
# warning. Do not add keys from a later vLLM -- the authoritative set is the `EngineArgs` class in
# this engine's own checkout.
#
# THIS FILE IS READ LINE BY LINE as `key: value`, and a value beginning `{` or `[` is parsed as
# JSON. An indented YAML block silently never reaches the engine args, so a structured value must
# stay on ONE line.

model: h2oai/h2ogpt-4096-llama2-7b-chat
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
swap-space: 16
block-size: 16
seed: 0
